title: Solve Crude Oil Scheduling Problems by Using Quantum-Classical Hybrid Algorithms
summary: The optimization of front-end crude oil scheduling is a critical determinant of refinery profitability and operational stability. However, the coupling of discrete logistics events (e.g., vessel berthing) with continuous material flows (e.g., pipeline transfers) renders this problem an NP-hard Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) challenge, often intractable for classical solvers at industrial scales.
